questions.question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 8000 at 15% per annum for 2 years (compounded annually.)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs.8000

Rate = 15% ; time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)T

Compound interest (C.I) = Amount (A) - principal (P)

**Calculation:**

Amount (A) = P × {1 + (R/100)}T

⇒ 8000 × {1 + (15/100)}²

 

⇒ 8000 × {23/20}²

 

⇒ 8000 × {529/400}

 

⇒ 529 × 20 = Rs.10580

 

Compound interest (C.I) = Amount (A) - principal (P)

⇒ 10580 - 8000 = Rs.2580

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.2580.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

**Calculation:**

Effective rate for 2 years = R + R + (R × R)/100

⇒ 15 + 15 + (15 × 15)/100

⇒ 30 + 2.25 = 32.25%

Compound interest (C.I) = 8000 × 32.25% = Rs.2580

∴ The correct answer is Rs.2580

A man rows to a place situated 100 km away and comes back in 10 hours. He can row 12 km downstream or 8 km upstream in same time. What is the speed of the stream?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since time is constant, the ratio of Downstream (D) to Upstream (U) speed is equal to the distance ratio = 12 : 8 = 3 : 2.

Let D = 3x and U = 2x. The total round-trip time for 100 km is 10 hours.

100 ÷ 3x + 100 ÷ 2x = 10 ⇒ 50 ÷ 6x = 1 ⇒ x = 25/3.

D = 3 × 25/3 = 25 km/hr and U = 2 × 25/3 = 50/3 km/hr.

Speed of stream = (D − U) ÷ 2 = (25 − 50/3) ÷ 2 = 25/6 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 25/6 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance of one-way journey = 100 km

Total time taken for the round trip = 10 hours

Distance covered downstream in time t = 12 km

Distance covered upstream in time t = 8 km

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Speed of stream = (Downstream Speed − Upstream Speed) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c4ccab1ecab213e2770f33ed44d479849acd6615481a83aee4cfc067c2d9b76.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ The time taken to row 12 km downstream is the same as the time to row 8 km upstream.

⇒ Ratio of Downstream Speed (D) to Upstream Speed (U) = 12 ÷ 8 = 3 / 2

⇒ Let D = 3x km/hr and U = 2x km/hr

⇒ Total time for the round trip = 10 hours

⇒ (100 ÷ 3x) + (100 ÷ 2x) = 10

⇒ Dividing the entire equation by 10:

⇒ (10 ÷ 3x) + (10 ÷ 2x) = 1

⇒ (20 + 30) ÷ 6x = 1

⇒ 50 ÷ 6x = 1

⇒ x = 25/3

⇒ Downstream Speed (D) = 3 × (25/3) = 25 km/hr

⇒ Upstream Speed (U) = 2 × (25/3) = 50/3 km/hr

⇒ Speed of stream = (D − U) ÷ 2

⇒ Speed of stream = (25 − 50/3) ÷ 2

⇒ Speed of stream = ((75 − 50) ÷ 3) ÷ 2

⇒ Speed of stream = (25/3) ÷ 2 = 25/6 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 25/6 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed of Boat in Still Water

If downstream speed is D and upstream speed is U, then the speed of the boat in still water is calculated as (D + U) ÷ 2.

Speed of Stream

The speed of the water current (stream) is half the difference between the downstream and upstream speeds, given by the formula (D − U) ÷ 2.

Average Speed for Round Trip

When a boat travels equal distances downstream and upstream, its average speed for the entire journey is independent of distance and equals (2 × D × U) ÷ (D + U).

questions.question: The difference between simple interest and compound interest (compounding of interest is done annually) on a certain sum of money for 3 years at the rate of 20 percent per annum is Rs. 192. What is the sum?
questions.solution:
Given:

The difference between simple interest and compound interest (compounding of interest is done annually) on a certain sum of money for 3 years at the rate of 20 percent per annum is Rs. 192. 

Formula used:

Difference between CI and SI in 3 yr = P( R /100)² {( R/100) + 3}

Calculation:

Let the principal is P

As per the question,

⇒ 192 = P( 20 /100)2 {( 20/100) + 3}

⇒ 192 = P( 1/5)2 {( 1/5 + 3}

⇒ P = 4800 / 3.2

⇒ P = Rs 1500

**∴ The correct option is** **3**

questions.question: A person bought some pens at the rate of 25 for a rupee and sold them at the rate of 20 for a rupee. What is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Cost price = 25 for a rupee

Selling price = 20 for a rupee

**Formula used**

Profit% = (S.P - C.P)/C.P × 100

**Calculation**

The cost price of 1 pen = Rs. 1/25

Selling price of 1 pen = Rs. 1/20

Profit % = [{(1/20) – (1/25)} / (1/25)] × 100

Profit % = (25 / 100) × 100

**The profit percentage is 25%.**

questions.question: Two taps P and Q can fill a tank alone in 10 hours and 12 hours respectively. If the two taps are opened at 9 a.m., then at what time should the tap P be closed to completely fill the tank at exactly 3 p.m.?
questions.solution:
Given:

Two taps P and Q can fill a tank alone in 10 hours and 12 hours respectively

Calculation:

Let the capacity of the tank = 60 litres (LCM of 10 and 12)

The efficiency of pipe P = 60/10

= 6 litres/hour

The efficiency of pipe Q = 60/12 

= 5 litres/hour

According to the question,

Total time in which tank has filled = 6 hours (3 p.m - 9 a.m)

Let the pipe P was closed at after n hours

According to the question

⇒ 6 × (n) + 5 × 6 = 60

⇒ 6n + 30 = 60

⇒ 6n = 30

⇒ n = 5

**So, 5 hours after 9:00 am. which means 2:00 pm, **the tap P should be closed at 3: 00 pm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab777b338e076ebcb2cdb89e2ff2843a1499dfb3df00b235186d1c5e1857e625.png] __Confusion Points__

Not asking about after how many hours the tap should be stopped. It is asking about the time (in p.m.) when the tap will be stopped. [Which is mentioned in the question]

Start at 9 a.m + 5 hours = 2 p.m

questions.question: The alcohol and water in a mixture are in the ratio of 4 ∶ 5 respectively. 20 litre water is added to it. If the ratio of alcohol and water in the new mixture is 1 ∶ 3 respectively, then what is the total quantity of the alcohol in the new mixture?
questions.solution:
Given:

The alcohol and water in a mixture = 4 : 5

The ratio of alcohol and water in the new mixture = 1 : 3

Calculation:

Suppose total mixture = 9x liters

Alcohol content = 4/9 × 9x = 4x liters

Water content = 9x - 4x = 5x liters

According to the question,

4x/(5x + 20) = 1/3

⇒ 12x = 5x + 20

⇒ 7x = 20

⇒ x = 20/7

The initial quantity of a mixture(i.e 9x) = 180/7

The total quantity of the new mixture = 180/7 + 20 = 320/7

The alcohol in the new mixture = 1/4 × (320/7) = 80/7

**The total quantity of alcohol in the new mixture is 80/7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/661340121ece4245dffae37dda41ddab0ce1f2bf0ba4a0210bff82185deedb2e.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The alcohol and water are in the ratio of 4 : 5

Now, 20 litres of water is added and the ratio becomes 1 : 3

So, we have to equal the unit of alcohol in both the ratio

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 Alcohol
 Water
 
 

 Before × 1
 4
 5
 
 

 After × 4
 4
 12
 
 

 

So, water is added (12 - 5) = 7 unit → 20 litre

So, the quantity of alcohol is 4 units → (20/7) × 4 = 80/7 litres

questions.question: The average of 7 consecutive odd numbers is A. If next 3 and previous 2 odd numbers to these 7 odd numbers are also included, then what is the new average of these 12 consecutive odd numbers?
questions.solution:
**Formula used:-**

Sum of n terms of AP = n/2(2a + (n - 1)d)

where ‘a’ is first term and ‘d’ is common difference

**Calculation:-**

Let the first odd number be x

Sum of first 7 odd numbers = 7/2(2x + 6 × 2) = 7x + 42

Average of first 7 odd numbers = (7x + 42)/7 = x + 6 = A

The new first term in the new case = x - 4

Sum of 12 odd numbers = 12/2(2(x - 4) + 11 × 2) = 12(x + 7) = 12x + 84

Average of 12 odd numbers = (12x + 84)/12 = x + 7 = A + 1 

**∴ The required answer is A + 1**

questions.question: A can do a work in 48 days. What part of the total work can be done by A in 18 days?
questions.solution:
**Detailed solution:- **

Let's assume that the total work is represented by W.

A can do the total work (W) in = 48 days.

So,

A can-do 1/48th of the total work in one day.

Now,

In 18 days A can do 18 × (1/48) = 18/48 = 3/8 of the total work.

**∴ A can-do 3/8 of the total work in __18__ days. **

questions.question: The marked price of a calculator is Rs. 1600. It is sold at a discount of 28 percent. If the cost price of the calculator is Rs. 700, then what is the value of profit?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The marked price of the calculator = Rs. 1600

It sold discount of = 28%

The cost price of the calculator = Rs. 700

**Concept:**

Profit = Selling price - Cost price

**Formula used:**

Selling price = Marked price - Discount

**Calculation:**

Let the selling price be S

According to the question

⇒ S = ({1-{28over100}})times 1600={72over100}times 1600=1152

The profit = 1152 - 700 = 452

**∴ The required result will be Rs. 452.**

questions.question: An article is sold at 5 percent loss. If its cost price is decreased by Rs. 20 and selling price is increased by Rs. 13, then profit of 10 percent is earned on it. What is the original selling price of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The cost price is decreased by = Rs. 20 and selling price is increased by Rs. 13

The profit = 10%

**Concept:**

Profit = Selling price - Cost price

**Formula used:**

P = SP - CP Where, P = Profit, SP = Selling price, and CP = Cost price

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price is C and selling price is S

The selling price is initially = 0.95C

The new cost price = C - 20

The new selling price = 0.95C + 13

The profit earned on new prices = 10%

The new selling price = ({C-20})× {110over100}=({C-20})× {11over10}

⇒ ({C-20})× {11over10} = 0.95C + 13

⇒ 11C - 220 = 9.5C + 130

⇒ 11C - 9.5C = 220 + 130

⇒ 1.5C = 350

⇒ C = {350over 1.5} = 233.33

The original selling price = {95over100}times C={0.95times 233.33}=221.66

**∴ The required result will be Rs. 221.66.**

questions.question: The ratio of the volume of two cylinders is 27 ∶ 25 and the ratio of their heights is 3 ∶ 4. If the area of the base of the second cylinder is 3850 cm², then what will be the radius of the first cylinder?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the volume of the two cylinders = 27 : 25

The ratio of the heights of the cylinders = 3 : 4

The area of the base of the second cylinder = 3850 cm²

**Formula used:**

A = π × r² Where, A = Area of the base of the cylinder, and h = Height of the cylinder

V = π × r² × h Where, V = Volume of the cylinder, r = Radius of the cylinder, and h = Height of the cylinder

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of the first cylinder be R and second cylinder be r volume of the first cylinder be 27v and second cylinder be 25v and height of the first cylinder be 3x and height of the second cylinder be 4x

According to the question

⇒ 27v = π × (3x) × R² ---(1)

⇒ 3850 = π × r² 

⇒ 3850 = {22over 7}× r²

⇒ 175 × 7 = r²

⇒ r = √1225 = 35 cm

The volume of the second cylinder = 25v

⇒ 3850 × (4x) = 25v

⇒ 154 × (4x) = v

⇒ v = 616x

The volume of the first cylinder = 27v = 27 × (616x) = 

⇒ 27 × (616x) = {22over7}× R²× 3x 

⇒ 27 × 28 × 7 = 3 × R²

⇒ 9 × 28 × 7 = R²

⇒ 1764 = R²

⇒ R = √1764 = 42

**∴ The required result will be 42.**
